newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-FOREKS GROUP PROFIT 31.1 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-FOREKS GROUP PROFIT 31.1 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Forekspank group consolidated unaudited net profit was 31.1 million kroons in the first quarter, it said on Monday.
The net profit makes up 41.4 percent of the profit estimate, it added in its statement. It estimates a net profit of 75 million kroons for 1997 compared to 46.1 million kroons in 1996.
Out of the consolidated profit, Forekspank had a profit of 28.99 million kroons, Foreks Liising one million kroons and Foreks Securities 1.1 million kroons.
Forekspank did not have consolidated net profit in 1996, but the bank accounts for 95 percent of group, which had a net profit of 9.48 million kroons in the first quarter of 1996.
